idea: Body parts (Friday school readiness, long 2:30 learning song) in JIMMY'S ROOM: a shiny rainbow soap bubble lands right on Baby Jimmy's nose ('Pop! Oh, wow! A bubble on my nose!'); chorus 'Nose and ears, tummy and toes! Touch them, touch them, here we go!'; each verse starts with a surprise bubble landing on the next body part – nose (boop, sniff sniff), ears (listen), tummy (pat pat pat), toes (wiggle wiggle); clap break (copy-me claps); review 'Nose! Ears! Tummy! Toes!' and the question 'Where is your nose? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'There it is! Boop! Yay!'; lesson: I know my body – nose, ears, tummy, toes. Loop: the hook framing again, bubble on his nose, bye-bye wave.

learning.goal: Name and touch four body parts: nose, ears, tummy, toes
learning.shown_how: a soap bubble lands on each body part in order; Jimmy shows it (sniff, cupped ears, pats tummy, wiggles toes)
learning.song_repeats: chorus x4 names all four; each verse names its part 4+ times; review at 1:50
learning.interactive_moment: 1:58 'Where is your nose? Hmm?' + 2 s pause, answer 2:03
learning.copy_me: touch your nose/ears, pat your tummy, wiggle your toes, clap your hands (1:38 clap break)
learning.fact_check: four body parts named while that part is shown; no counting on screen (toes line 'ten little toes' is true)
learning.toddler_fit: one baby, calm cozy room, big face, bubbles gentle

story_order: bubble lands on nose (hook), ears, tummy, toes each only from its own verse

shots.role: HOOK – bubble on nose, gasp, pop, giggle
NOSE – bubble wobbling on nose, sniff sniff (from hook frame; f3 boop frames rejected: finger looked like nose-poking)
EARS – hands cupped behind ears, bubble pops by ear
TUMMY – bubble on tummy pops, pat pat pat
TOES – feet up, bubble on toes pops, wiggle
CLAP BREAK – standing, clapping above head
LOOP ENDING – edit of hook frame, bye-bye wave, bubble on nose

song: lyria-3.5, 150.5 s, timeline in song.txt / song_prompt.txt
